An aspiring '''writer''' [[Marriage/Legends|married]] the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|Handmaiden]] [[Teckla Minnau/Legends|Teckla Minnau]] [[Time/Legends|sometime]] after she returned to her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Minnau's employer, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]],<ref name="DB" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Through the mariage, Teckla's spouse became related to her [[Minnau family|family]], including her brother [[Rehtul Minnau]] and her half-sister [[Nandi]].<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Teckla Minnau's spouse was mentioned in her [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry,<ref name="DB" /> which was published on [[StarWars.com]] in [[2008]]. The entry was written as part of the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] fan club feature "[[What's The Story?]],"<ref name="PP">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode311.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> in which subscribers would submit character backstories that, if selected, would officially become part of ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].<ref name="Story">{{SWArchive|url=hyperspace/about/news/news20050624.html|text=Hyperspace Presents: What's the Story?}}</ref> Minnau's entry was written by the user [[Evan Burger|ShadowCultist]].<ref name="DB" /> The [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|''The Clone Wars'': The Lost Missions]] episode "[[An Old Friend]]," which premiered on [[February 22]], [[2014]],<ref name="German TV Schedule">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fernsehserien.de/star-wars-the-clone-wars/episodenguide/staffel-6/9660|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars Staffel 6 Episodenguide|work=[https://www.fernsehserien.de fernsehserien.de]|archivedate=20200102003447}}</ref> featured Minnau's [[Death/Legends|death]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], prior to Amidala's death, thus leaving the canonicity of her spouse within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity uncertain.<ref name="TCW">{{TCW|An Old Friend}}</ref>
